name: GXO Abercrombie & Fitch Distribution Center - Goodyear AZ

fieldNotes.truckGate: Confirmed at z21: a cantilever/rolling gate spans the truck driveway at the NE corner where the entrance road meets the truck court; clear pinch-point with lane markings.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Confirmed at z21: a small dark booth structure sits beside the gate lane, separate from the main building (≈1-2 vehicle footprint). Street View 2024-09 shows the gate and screening wall.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock building — dock doors with trailers backed in on BOTH the north face and the south face (separate dock banks on opposite faces). z18 full view confirms.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ band confident. dockDoorCount 130 is an estimate counting dock-door rhythm across the north face (~65) and south face (~65); flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Drop yard of parked trailers along the north truck court and at the NE corner; 25-50 stalls of parked trailers without tractors.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide truck court and generous gate apron at the NE entrance leave room for a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: PV303 master-planned industrial park, NE corner of Thomas & Citrus Rds, within the Phoenix metropolitan area; multiple adjacent large DCs. Urban.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Single A&F building; the two-tone roof reflects a phased roof installation, not separate structures. Other PV303 buildings are separate properties, excluded.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: From perimeter box ~378m N-S x ~762m E-W ≈ 71 acres.
